slot_b_text: This is the 19th flight for B1085. It is aiming for the drone ship A Shortfall of Gravitas, 600 km downrange. It last flew Starlink Group 10-19 about 2 months ago.
description: Dedicated rideshare flight to a mid-inclination orbit with dozens of small microsatellites and nanosatellites for commercial and government customers. This launch also carries the second demonstration mission for SpaceX’s Project Starfall, which aims to mass-produce reentry capsules designed to autonomously transport valuable customer experiments and other payloads safely back from space to Earth, including for in-orbit manufacturing.
rocket_fact: Ion thrusters can produce only about as much thrust as the weight of a sheet of paper, but can run continuously for months or years.
